rules.source: The Fund holds between 18 and 22 equally weighted positions selected from the investment universe.
rules.note: Positions are stated to be equally weighted, which is how the benchmark weights holdings, so no separate weighting rule is needed.

rules.source: No single holding may exceed 7% of the portfolio
no more than 15% of the portfolio may be invested in any one sector
The portfolio is spread across at least eight sectors.
The Fund invests only in companies domiciled in the Nordic region or Western Europe.
rules.note: Domicile is read as the region category in the universe data.

rules.source: No more than 25% of the portfolio may be invested in companies from a single country.
Companies with a market capitalisation below EUR 1 billion are not eligible.
rules.note: market_cap_eur_bn is in EUR billions, so one billion is 1.

rules.source: The Fund does not invest in companies involved in the production of tobacco or in controversial weapons.
rules.note: The tobacco and controversial_weapons flags are taken to stand for involvement in production; the data cannot show degree of involvement.

rules.source: Companies that derive more than 5% of their revenue from thermal coal are excluded.
rules.note: The thermal_coal flag is taken to stand for the 5% revenue threshold; the data cannot show revenue shares.

rules.source: Within each sector, the companies whose ESG score falls in the lowest 20% of that sector are not eligible for investment.
The average ESG score of the portfolio must be at least 5% higher than the average of the investment universe.
rules.note: The portfolio average is treated as an average over holdings.

rules.source: The portfolio's average carbon intensity must be at least 25% below that of the investment universe.
rules.note: Carbon intensity is read as the carbon field; the average is treated as an average over holdings.

rules.source: On average, women must make up at least 34% of the board members of portfolio companies.
rules.note: The average is treated as an average over holdings.

rules.source: At least half of the portfolio is invested in companies with validated science-based emissions reduction targets.
rules.note: The sbti_target flag is taken to mean validated science-based targets.

rules.source: The Fund aims to reduce the carbon intensity of the portfolio by 7% each year.
rules.reason: A target that changes over time. It would need historical or multi-period carbon data for the portfolio, and the universe data is a single snapshot.

rules.source: The expected tracking error of the portfolio against the investment universe will not exceed 6% per year.
At least 80% of the Fund's assets will be invested in companies whose activities are aligned with the EU Taxonomy.
rules.reason: The universe has no EU Taxonomy alignment flag or field. Data on each company's Taxonomy-aligned share of activities would be needed.

rules.source: The manager votes at all shareholder meetings
rules.reason: A voting commitment about manager conduct, not a restriction on which assets are held. It cannot be tested with asset data.

rules.source: engages with investee companies on their climate transition plans.
rules.reason: An engagement commitment about manager conduct, not a restriction on which assets are held. It cannot be tested with asset data.
